assertions.subject: Undifferentiated Pleomorphic Sarcoma
assertions.quote: Complex karyotype (80%–85% of sarcomas): These tumors are usually aneuploid or polyploid and demonstrate multiple chromosomal gains and losses, a feature that suggests underlying genomic instability. Examples http://ebooksmedicine.net include leiomyosarcoma and undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma.
